It conveys a sense of familial warmth, as the name implies the bond between an elder brother and a younger one. Jogen is also identified with the beloved younger brother of Lord Krishna, and therefore, holds a deep connection to the tales, legends, and tradition of the Hindu deity.
data.spiritual_significance: The spiritual significance of the name Jogen is influenced by its association with Lord Krishna as his younger brother. In Hinduism, Jogen represents the eternal bond between brothers, siblings, and devotees. This spiritual meaning is rooted in ancient Indian wisdom and reinforces the important social role of the younger brother in Hindu society. Additionally, Jogen signifies the loving, caring, and protective nature of Lord Krishna towards his younger brother, emphasizing the profound devotion and unwavering commitment shared between brothers and the divine.
